Spoke to @SkyNews about ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran, more peace talks in Pakistan, the opening of the Straight of Hormuz, conflict in Lebanon, and the high civilian toll of this war across the Middle East.

Video

I talked to @The_NewArab about how Israel pushed the idea that Iran is a paper tiger, which Trump naively believed, and that the Islamic Republic is weak to the point that Iran could be finished with one final blow.

It has turned out to be completely false for many reasons. Tehran understands itself as being on the defensive in this war while resisting American-Israeli aggression, and has put up a pretty fierce fight.

Great piece by @GiorgioCafiero 
newarab.com/analysis/iran-wa…

Told @BBCWorld that ceasefire in Lebanon is first step towards permanent peace. But a significant gap remains between Tehran and Washington. U.S. pressure on Iran has not produced capitulation. Yet serious, sustained diplomacy can offer a viable path forward.

Video

Formidable and unfiltered, Egyptian journalist @rahmazeinegypt challenges the failures of mainstream media in covering Gaza, Iran, and beyond.

In contrast, social media has emerged as a rare window into lived realities on the ground through independent voices.

Also honored to meet the courageous physicians of @docstopgenocide.

At Busboys and Poets in Washington

Trump and Tehran both want the war to end, but each on their own terms.

Trump wants a fast exit. Energy prices are straining the global economy and the U.S., and the war is unpopular at home. But he needs something that looks like a decisive win, ideally, surrender. Iran won’t give him that.

I spoke to @NPR about US-Iran peace talks failing in Islamabad, the continued blockade of the Straight of Hormuz, and what’s next after a month of war in the Middle East.

Video

I spoke to @NPR about historic peace talks between Iran and the U.S. led by VP Vance and Iranian Speaker of Parliament Qalibaf.

Talks in Islamabad ended without a deal, leaving the Strait of Hormuz closed and putting a fragile ceasefire at risk.
the1a.org/segments/recent-ne…

I told @MiddleEastEye that Vance leading peace talks with Iran showed a lot of seriousness from the U.S. It was a major step up from past two rounds of negotiations led by Special Envoy Witkoff.

And on the Iranian side also, the speaker of parliament Ghalibaf was a very good match for the VP. It showed seriousness from Tehran.
middleeasteye.net/news/make-…

Joined @AJEnglish to discuss U.S.–Iran talks in Islamabad, the central importance of ceasefire terms, the threat of spoilers, and Pakistan’s emerging role as a mediator working to keep diplomacy alive.

Video

Told @AJEnglish that Iran is serious about peace talks with the U.S. in Pakistan, and equally serious about the terms of the ceasefire.

Israel’s massive attacks on Lebanon aim to sabotage the negotiations and risk provoking Iran back into the fight.

Video

John Kerry: I was part of many conversations with Netanyahu. He wanted us to strike Iran. He came to Obama and made a presentation to ask to strike. Obama refused. Biden refused. Bush refused. The only president who agreed is Trump.

Video

Told CNN that there is a sigh of relief in Iran and across the region including here in Doha after the ceasefire. Iran was the underdog in this war but put up a big fight against two super powers and was able to force some of its conditions.
Thank you @BeckyCNN
